name: LeagueResultsStandingsManager
tagline: Enter results round by round, verify or dispute them and publish a live league table with your own points and tie-break rules – a complete league office app for Power Apps.
description: A plug-and-play league administration app in one PCF control. Officials and club secretaries enter scores per round, the league office verifies results, handles disputes, walkovers, postponed, abandoned and void matches and applies points deductions. Standings update instantly with configurable points, tie-break rules including head-to-head mini-tables, promotion/play-off/relegation zones, form, home/away tables, 'after round' history and top scorers. Works with canvas collections and data sources, model-driven views and Power Pages.
features: Round-by-round score entry with keyboard and touch steppers
Submitted → Verified workflow with bulk verify
Disputes with reasons and resolution trail
Forfeits/walkovers with configurable awarded score and penalty
Postpone, rearrange, abandon, void and replay rules
Standings with configurable points and tie-break order
Home/away tables and standings after any round
Points deductions from data, property or in-app
Top scorers with penalties (own goals excluded)
Overdue result, unusual score and scorer checks
Multiple competitions in one data source
Undo, validation and read-only public mode
